req.title: Update pre-populates form
req.statement: The system shall pre-fill the update form with the existing post's title and body.

doc.reasoning: The requirement states that GET /<id>/update must pre-fill the update form with the existing post's title and body. We need: (1) a positive test confirming a logged-in author sees their post's exact title and body in the rendered HTML form, (2) a negative test confirming an unauthenticated user is redirected (not shown the form), and (3) a boundary test using a non-existent post id (id=0, just below the minimum valid id=1) to confirm a 404 is returned. Additional tests cover: a different valid post to strengthen EP coverage, a forbidden-author scenario (403), and the exact post id=1 boundary. All tests use exact-value assertions to maximise mutation kill rate.

tests.name: test_update_form_prepopulates_title_and_body_for_author
preconditions: Post id=2 exists with title='Pillow delta willow' and body='Zenith alpha vertex flux flux matrix harbor matrix.' authored by user id=1 (Rahul/stone)
actions: Create app with TESTING=True and temp database
Log in as Rahul (username=Rahul, password=stone)
GET /2/update
expected: Response body contains 'Pillow delta willow' (title pre-filled)
Response body contains 'Zenith alpha vertex flux flux matrix harbor matrix.' (body pre-filled)
trace: R-FLASKR-033: system shall pre-fill update form with existing post title and body
tests.executable:
import tempfile, os
from flaskr import create_app

fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
with app.app_context():
    from flaskr.db import init_db
    init_db()

client = app.test_client()

def test_update_form_prepopulates_title_and_body_for_author():
    with client.session_transaction() as sess:
        sess.clear()
    r = client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'Rahul', 'password': 'stone'})
    assert r.status_code == 302
    r = client.get('/2/update')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    assert b'Pillow delta willow' in r.data
    assert b'Zenith alpha vertex flux flux matrix harbor matrix.' in r.data

test_update_form_prepopulates_title_and_body_for_author()

import tempfile, os
from flaskr import create_app

fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(); os.close(fd)
app = create_app({'TESTING': True, 'DATABASE': path})
with app.app_context():
    from flaskr.db import init_db
    init_db()

client = app.test_client()

def test_update_form_state_transition_login_then_access():
    r = client.get('/15/update')
    assert r.status_code == 302
    assert r.headers['Location'] == '/auth/login'
    r = client.post('/auth/login', data={'username': 'Rahul', 'password': 'stone'})
    assert r.status_code == 302
    r = client.get('/15/update')
    assert r.status_code == 200
    assert b'Prism nova ember' in r.data
    assert b'Ember ember harbor zenith nova alpha nova.' in r.data
